summary: V1 foundation tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass — new fields (today_score.contributors, safety {level/reasons/headline}, confidence {label/score/notes/has_marine}), new endpoints (/api/ai/why-here, /api/ai/why-now, /api/ai/regulations), /api/hotspots (~25 spots near Treasure Island FL incl. piers/jetties/boat ramps/marinas/beaches, sorted by distance), Nominatim-based /api/reverse-geocode returns granular 'Treasure Island' rather than 'Tampa Bay'. All prior endpoints (forecast inland & coastal, ai/species/almanac/recommend, geocode, spots/catches CRUD) still pass. Frontend: Onboarding flow redirects fresh visit -> /onboarding, all 3 legal cards present (legal-row-tos/privacy/waiver), continue button (accept-continue-button) gated by 3 switches; accept persists fishcast.legal_acceptance and routes to /(tabs). Today screen shows confidence-chip ('Confidence: High'), hotspots-button, regulations-button, score-breakdown (positive +4/+4/+3/+2/+1/+1/+1 and negative -2 contributors with signed delta pills), fishing-score, verdict-badge. SafetyBanner correctly hidden (safety.level='Safe'). /hotspots route shows hotspots-list with >10 coastal spots. /regulations shows AI-generated FWC summary in regulations-body + disclaimer card. /location modal exposes use-gps-button and pick-on-map-button.

minor.issue: compute_fishing_score adds 'swell' to factors when coastal but never adds 'swell' to the weights dict — so swell is silently excluded from BOTH the weighted total score AND the contributors list. The reviewer-visible breakdown therefore never shows a swell contributor on coastal locations (only tide/solunar/pressure/wind/clouds/temp/precip). server.py:322-329, 332-334. Fix: add 'swell' to both branches of the weights dict (e.g. 0.08-0.10 weight when present).
Function has a fully duplicated dead block (lines 386-495) — appears to be a leftover from a refactor; the early return at line 379 prevents it from executing. Should be deleted for clarity.

issues: Distance values render as '1570.0 m', '2130.0 m', etc. Backend returns distance_km (e.g. 1.57). Likely the formatter is multiplying km by 1000 or rendering wrong unit; numbers should be '1.57 km' or '1570 m' but never both decimals + 'm'. Quick read suggests formatter prints km with 'm' suffix.
Score breakdown card is correct, but consider adding a swell row once backend bug above is fixed.
Persisting cosmetic RN-web console warnings: 'shadow*' (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' (use textShadow), props.pointerEvents (move to style.pointerEvents). Not blocking.

rca_of_issue: Swell silently excluded: in server.py compute_fishing_score, swell is computed and added to `factors` dict when coastal, but `weights` dict is never updated to include 'swell'. The contributor builder at lines 351-368 has `if k not in weights: continue`, so swell is skipped. The weighted total at lines 332-334 also only iterates keys present in weights. Net effect: swell scoring is dead code on coastal locations. Fix: add 'swell': 0.08 (or similar) to both weight dicts (the no-tide and with-tide variants), rebalancing other weights to sum to ~1.0.
